item.title: What would you like The Local Sweden to cover in the year ahead?
item.description: It’s been a busy 12 months at The Local Sweden, given the government’s moves to tighten citizenship laws and slow down awards. But we’ve also covered traditions, culture, politics and more. What would you like us to cover next year?

item.title: What will happen to wages in Sweden in 2026?
item.description: A recovery in the labour market will lead to rising real wages and will contribute to increased household incomes in 2026, according to recent reports from Sweden's central bank and private sector economists.

item.title: How to analyse a Swedish housing association's finances before you buy an apartment
item.description: When you buy an apartment in Sweden, you're usually actually buying into a housing association (bostadsrättsförening), and it's crucial to understand the state of their finances to make sure your investment is secure.

item.title: Ten Swedish life hacks that will make you feel like a local
item.description: Sweden can be a cold and unforgiving place, with strange rules and customs. For newbies there can be some surprising culture shocks, so here are some tips to make your life in Sweden a little easier.

item.title: TELL US: Is life in India better than it is in Sweden?
item.description: More and more Indians living and working in Sweden are returning home to India, drawn by the booming economy, better sense of community, and family ties. We want to hear from Indian readers where they think the quality of life is better.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: dammsugare
item.description: Here's a Swedish word that has two meanings, one useful and one delicious.

item.title: Nordic countries seize thousands of potentially harmful fake Labubu dolls
item.description: Authorities in Denmark have issued a warning over potential harmful chemicals in fake Labubu dolls after authorities in Sweden, Norway and Denmark confiscated almost 9,000 of the counterfeit toys.

item.title: Sweden's youth are prioritizing 'granny hobbies' and coziness in 2026
item.description: The 2026 youth trend report from the 'Youth Barometer' organization identifies “all forms of coziness” as the top trend for young people in the new year. Specific trends were alone time, knitting, picking wild mushrooms, and community running groups.

item.title: How good is your Swedish vocabulary? - Quiz 15
item.description: It's quiz time again in this week's episode of Sweden in Focus Extra for Membership+ subscribers.

item.title: Sweden 'has plan' to push forward citizenship law despite test delays
item.description: Sweden's government has a plan to bring in its centrepiece citizenship test law next year, despite the universities responsible for language and civics exams saying they cannot meet the deadline of next August.
